ownership_rules.checkpoint_immutability: checkpoints update/delete require a 'confirm' query parameter to be PRESENT (any value, including confirm=0); superuser bypass
ownership_rules.reconcile_semantics: POST /accounts/{id}/reconcile creates AT MOST ONE transaction per call; 400 'no unexplained checkpoint gap to reconcile' when there is nothing to do; not safe to blind-retry
ownership_rules.is_admin_protection: app.go:150-176 forces isAdmin=false on non-superuser create and restores the original value on update

attachments.detection: http.DetectContentType on bytes, not the declared header
attachments.rollback: all-or-nothing; records created earlier in a failed request are deleted

web.route_components: none per-route; app.tsx maps pathname to a SidebarTab and a single BudgetingDashboard switches on it
web.query_note: QueryClientProvider mounted in main.tsx but no useQuery/useMutation anywhere in the repo
web.openapi_note: only the six finance LIST operations are registered with Huma; every other route is undocumented
web.data_access: hand-rolled fetch via apps/web/src/api/client.ts apiFetch, plus the pocketbase-js SDK

inherited_unused_taskboard.verification_method: server: wired into registerRoutes/hooks AND no reachable web caller. web: absent from the import graph rooted at apps/web/src/main.tsx, computed by walking relative and @/ imports; test files excluded from the graph.

go.source_files_without_tests_note: internal/app/finance.go and asset_groups.go DO have tests (finance_test.go, asset_groups_test.go). config.go, app.go, auth.go, authorization.go, and all of internal/reminders/ have none. All 18 pb_migrations files are thin wrappers with no tests.
